marks.gloss_en: הכא בחטאת העוף עסקינן, דכולהו בהדי הדדי קאתי (= p_okimta_chatat_haof)
Rav Pappa: here we deal with a bird sin offering, where all [three liabilities] come together
Mar Zutra in Rav Pappa's name: half the windpipe deficient, he added any amount and completed it (= p_okimta_chatzi_kaneh_pagum)
כגון שהיה חצי קנה פגום והוסיף עליו כל שהוא וגמרו -- the minimal cut is itself the completion
Mar Zutra in Rav Pappa's name: where half the windpipe was deficient and he added any amount to it and completed it -- all come together
מכדי רב הונא כעולא, ועולא מעשה כל דהו קאמר -- even in a bird the first minimal cut forbids it, so the rest is cutting dirt
Rav Huna stated his ruling per Ulla, and Ulla said: any act at all [forbids]
אי הכי, מאי איריא חטאת? לישמעינן זבח! -- if so, why specifically a sin offering?
ואי אין אדם אוסר דבר שאינו שלו, מאי איריא חטאת העוף? אפילו חטאת בהמה נמי -- the animal sin offering is not his either
rather: where he says he worships it at the completion of the slaughter
Rav Pappa: were it not that Rav Huna said 'one siman', the chatat would be no refutation of him -- [one could say] what is 'an act'? a significant act
Rav Pappa: were it not that Rav Huna said 'another's animal', the chatat would be no refutation of him -- for his own he can forbid, another's he cannot
lest you say that since he acquires it for atonement it is like his own -- he teaches us [it is not]
a person does not render forbidden a thing that is not his
